english.title: Cause / permit vehicle to be used as hackney carriage without permit from LLAOL and licence from Luton BC
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be used as a hackney carriage plying for hire on Luton airport without a permit for that purpose issued by London Luton Airport Operations Limited and without a licence having been obtained for the vehicle under section 37 of the Town Police Clauses Act 1847 from Luton Borough Council
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 4.1 and 7.2 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
